name: Gandr
description: Gandr OpenAI compatible text-to-speech (MP3, WAV, PCM telephony).

apiKey.description: Gandr API key, sent as Authorization: Bearer <apiKey>. Falls back to GANDR_API_KEY env var. Keys are issued at https://gandr.ai; the free tier is 50,000 tokens.

baseUrl.description: Override Gandr API base URL (default https://tts.gandr.ai/v1).

voiceId.description: Voice identifier (default gandr-mia). Stock voices: gandr-mia, gandr-ava, gandr-jenny, gandr-dane, gandr-leo, gandr-lewis.

responseFormat.description: Audio attachment format (default mp3). Telephony always uses PCM.
